resharper_csharp_instance_members_qualify_declared_in #

Instance members qualification — Qualify members declared in ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified masked, and the arranger's. Masked by resharper_instance_members_qualify_members, which the export does not set and whose default is none. Set it to all and the oracle gives three distinct outputs across this_class, base_class, this_class and base_class — this._field, this.BaseField, this.BaseMethod() appear and disappear per value. It is performed by CSArrangeQualifiers under the cleanup profile and moves nothing under CSReformatCode, so it belongs to the arranger and not to the formatter.

Typeany combination, comma-separated, of this_class, base_class
Defaultthis_class, base_class
Default known fromthe Rider export, which is Rider's default for most keys and the author's choice for the rest, with nothing distinguishing the two
TierD — recorded so the key is not reported unknown; nothing reads it yet
